category_title: Senior primary boys with literacy underachievement and playground behavioral challenges
minimal_context: The student is sitting in the classroom working on a story writing task during a long literacy period.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit at your desk and spend this period writing your story.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to do writing. It's just boring stuff and there is lots of work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to complete your planned tasks for today.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I hate having to do stuff like this. I'd rather be outside playing tackle games with my friends.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just do your best and keep working on it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Displays complete inattention and lack of focus on tasks) No, I'm done. This is too much work and I'm just going to mess around until it's time to go to the playground.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please sit at your desk and spend this period writing your story.

STUDENT: (Displays complete inattention and lack of focus on tasks) No, I'm done. This is too much work and I'm just going to mess around until it's time to go to the playground.

task.content: Completing 'planned tasks' notably in 'literacy', such as 'writing stories' or 'reading'
task.learning_goal: Strive to have achieved, by year’s end, more than mediocre standards across a wide range of subject areas

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When faced with 'lots of work' and 'having to do stuff' over 'long periods of time'
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: 'inattention (lack of focus on tasks)' and 'rushing some work in order to get to break time'

behavior_patterns.condition: When required to 'sit around' learning over 'long periods of time'
When wanting to get to 'break time' or 'recreation times'
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: 'rushing some work in order to get to break time'
